subject.title: Add retry logic to OAuth token refresh

question: Should the shared auth-profile OAuth refresh path retry transient provider/plugin refresh failures by default, and what classifier and retry budget should define that policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but retrying auth refresh changes failure timing and can mask permanent OAuth failures or interact with provider-owned refresh hooks, so maintainer intent is needed before encoding policy.

options.title: Approve bounded shared retry
options.body: Use retryAsync around the shared refresh attempt with a narrow transient-error classifier, small retry budget, and focused tests for success-after-retry, retry exhaustion, and non-retryable OAuth failures.

options.title: Keep retries provider-owned
options.body: Leave the shared manager single-shot and require providers or plugins with known transient refresh behavior to implement their own retry policy.

options.title: Defer for live upstream proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer wants live provider failure proof before selecting generic retry behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded shared retry
recommendation.body: Use retryAsync around the shared refresh attempt with a narrow transient-error classifier, small retry budget, and focused tests for success-after-retry, retry exhaustion, and non-retryable OAuth failures.

likelyOwner.reason: The central OAuth lifecycle manager commit by vincentkoc is the owner boundary for shared retry placement.
